definitions.gloss: to check against; to compare; to cross-reference
definitions.explanation: To compare one thing with another to verify accuracy, consistency, or correspondence. Often used when checking data, documents, or information against a reference.

examples.japanese: リストと{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせてください。
examples.english: Please check it against the list.

examples.japanese: {原本|げんぽん}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせて{間違|まちが}いがないか{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked it against the original to make sure there were no errors.

examples.japanese: {規則|きそく}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせると、この{手続|てつづ}きは{正|ただ}しくないことが{分|わ}かった。
examples.english: When I checked it against the regulations, I found that this procedure was not correct.

notes:
A compound verb formed from {照|て}らす (to shine, to illuminate) and {合|あ}わせる (to put together). The image is of holding two things up to the light to compare them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原本|げんぽん}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to check against the original)
- {基準|きじゅん}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to compare against a standard)
- {事実|じじつ}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to check against the facts)
- {記録|きろく}と{照|て}らし{合|あ}わせる (to cross-reference with records)

Often used in formal or business contexts. The particle と marks the reference item being compared against.
